title: Comparatives 3: When the Last Consonant Changes
description: Six common comparatives swap their last consonant and end in -е: дороже (more expensive), тише (quieter), проще (simpler), ближе (closer), легче (easier), моложе (younger). Today you learn to spot and build these six.
descriptionRussian: Шесть частых сравнительных форм меняют последний согласный и оканчиваются на -е: дороже, тише, проще, ближе, легче, моложе. Сегодня вы учитесь узнавать и образовывать эти шесть форм.
intro: Six comparatives change their last consonant before the ending, which makes them look less like the adjectives they came from. There is no rule to apply here, and trying to derive them wastes time. Learn the six as whole words. They are common enough that you will have them inside a week.
rules: These six comparatives end in one -е, not -ее, and the last consonant of the stem changes.
Learn the six as whole words: дорогой → дороже, молодой → моложе, тихий → тише, близкий → ближе, простой → проще, лёгкий → легче.
Each form is one short word: no более is added.
The form never changes for gender or number. Дороже, моложе, тише, ближе, проще, легче stay the same for he, she, it, or they.
examples: Кофе дороже, чем чай. (Coffee is more expensive than tea.) дорогой → дороже, the г becomes ж.
Антон моложе своего брата. (Anton is younger than his brother.) молодой → моложе, the д becomes ж.
В этой комнате тише, чем на улице. (It is quieter in this room than outside.) тихий → тише, the х becomes ш.
Магазин ближе, чем парк. (The store is closer than the park.) близкий → ближе, the з becomes ж.
Этот вопрос проще, чем тот. (This question is simpler than that one.) простой → проще, the ст becomes щ.
Эта книга легче, чем учебник. (This book is easier than the textbook.) лёгкий → легче, the к becomes ч.

tables.title: The six words: the last consonant changes

items.promptEnglish: Coffee is more expensive than tea.
items.hint: Дорогой loses its г and ends in -е. What word do you get?
items.explanation: Дороже is the comparative of дорогой: the last consonant г becomes ж and the ending is a single -е.

items.promptEnglish: Anton is younger than his brother.
items.hint: Молодой changes its д to ж and ends in -е.
items.explanation: Моложе is the comparative of молодой: the д becomes ж and the ending is -е.

items.prompt: В этой комнате _____ , чем на улице.
items.promptEnglish: It is quieter in this room than outside.
items.hint: Тихий changes its х to ш and ends in -е.
items.explanation: Тише is the comparative of тихий: the х becomes ш and the ending is -е.

items.promptEnglish: The store is closer than the park.
items.hint: Близкий changes its з to ж and ends in -е.
items.explanation: Ближе is the comparative of близкий: the з becomes ж and the ending is -е.

items.promptEnglish: This question is simpler than that one.
items.hint: Простой changes its ст to щ and ends in -е.
items.explanation: Проще is the comparative of простой: the cluster ст becomes щ and the ending is -е.

items.promptEnglish: This book is easier than the textbook.
items.hint: Лёгкий changes its к to ч and ends in -е.
items.explanation: Легче is the comparative of лёгкий: the к becomes ч and the ending is -е.

blanks: Этот ресторан _____ , чем кафе. (This restaurant is more expensive than the café.)
Метро _____ , чем автобус. (The metro is closer than the bus.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Both answers are from today's six. Дороже (from дорогой, the г becomes ж) and ближе (from близкий, the з becomes ж) each end in a single -е.

errorCorrection.translationEnglish: This music is louder than that.
errorCorrection.explanation: The comparative of громкий is громче: the last consonant к becomes ч and the ending is a single -е. Громкее adds -ее to the unchanged stem, exactly the trap of this lesson; it is not a real word.

errorCorrection.sentence: Здесь климат сухее, чем на юге.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: The climate here is drier than in the south.
errorCorrection.explanation: The comparative of сухой is суше: the х becomes ш and the ending is -е, the same change as тихий → тише. Сухее adds -ее to the unchanged stem and is not a real word.

errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Anton calls more often than before.
errorCorrection.explanation: The comparative of частый / часто is чаще: the ст becomes щ and the ending is -е, the same change as простой → проще. Частее adds -ее to the unchanged stem and is not a real word.

errorCorrection.translationEnglish: This tea is stronger than that one.
errorCorrection.explanation: The comparative of крепкий is крепче: the к becomes ч and the ending is -е, the same change as лёгкий → легче. Крепкее adds -ее to the unchanged stem and is not a real word.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: This task is simpler than that one.
minimalPairs.explanation: Проще is the comparative of простой: the cluster ст becomes щ and the ending is -е. Простой is the plain form ('simple'), used to describe one thing, not to compare two.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: This backpack is lighter than the suitcase.
minimalPairs.explanation: Легче is the comparative of лёгкий: the к becomes ч and the ending is -е. Лёгкий is the plain form ('light, easy') and does not express 'lighter'.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: The park is closer than the train station.
minimalPairs.explanation: Ближе is the comparative of близкий: the з becomes ж and the ending is -е. Близкий is the plain form ('close, near') and cannot do the comparison by itself.

categorySorting.instruction: Sort each word: is it the plain adjective, or the comparative that ends in -е?

sentenceBuilding.translation: Coffee is more expensive than tea.
sentenceBuilding.hint: Start with the subject, then the comparative дороже (from дорогой).
Use проще, the comparative of простой (the ст becomes щ).

sentenceBuilding.translation: Anton is younger than his sister.
sentenceBuilding.hint: Use моложе, the comparative of молодой (the д becomes ж).

sentenceBuilding.translation: It became quieter in the room.
sentenceBuilding.hint: Use тише, the comparative of тихий (the х becomes ш).

reviewVocab.definition: дороже = more expensive (from дорогой; the last consonant г becomes ж, ending -е)
younger (from молодой; the д becomes ж, ending -е; the form never changes for gender or number)
quieter (from тихий; the х becomes ш, ending -е)
reviewVocab.example: В этой комнате тише, чем на улице.

reviewVocab.definition: closer, nearer (from близкий; the з becomes ж, ending -е)
simpler, easier (from простой; the cluster ст becomes щ, ending -е)
easier, lighter (from лёгкий; the к becomes ч, ending -е)
